title: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One

entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: A young Argivian cadet from Penregon, newly promoted to avenger pilot, who is paired with Sword One during the attack on Kroog.

entities.name: Rica
entities.description: A stoic Yotian cadet who becomes a pilot and flees with Sanwell.

entities.name: Carlo
entities.description: A cadet from Kroog's River Wards, promoted to pilot, who is badly burned and killed by Fallaji crossbowmen.

entities.name: Llora
entities.description: The stern Suwwardi instructor of the cadets, killed in the dragon engine's blast.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's chief apprentice, who promotes the cadets to pilots and briefs them, visibly afraid.

entities.name: Rendall
entities.description: Sanwell's younger brother, a cadet in the ornithopter corps stationed at the palace.

entities.name: Lieutenant Markos
entities.description: A young Yotian lieutenant commanding the plaza barricade.

entities.name: Aiman
entities.description: A wounded Fallaji brasscap soldier who lies among the dead, meets a glowing blue ghost he takes for Death, and loses an eye.

entities.name: Death
entities.description: A blue glowing ghostly figure with a far-eastern accent who tells Aiman 'Not yet' and says they are too early.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer whose machines the avengers are; he leads his forces elsewhere.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, whose forces attack Kroog with dragon engines and Fallaji.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: The Yotian capital, brick city of art and festivals, attacked and burned by Mishra's forces.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: Sanwell's native stoic city and a likely destination for evacuees.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: A neutral merchant city considered as an evacuation destination.

entities.name: Hench
entities.description: A caravan town in the east where the army is told to gather.

entities.name: Mardun
entities.description: The river that Mishra's force crossed to take the River Wards.

entities.name: River Wards
entities.description: A district of Kroog along the Mardun taken by Mishra's force.

entities.name: Orniary
entities.description: The artifice school and yard in Kroog where cadets train with avengers.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The land of many gods, whose capital Kroog is under attack.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Sanwell's homeland, known for ponderous ceremonies.

entities.name: Sword One
entities.description: A new sword-pattern prototype avenger paired to Sanwell, which fights on after its pilots flee.

entities.name: Sword Two
entities.description: Rica's sword-pattern avenger, destroyed by Fallaji bomb lances.

entities.name: Sword Three
entities.description: Carlo's avenger, which is pulled down while idle.

entities.name: Sword Four
entities.description: An avenger left fighting after its pilot died.

entities.name: Sword Five
entities.description: An avenger left fighting after its pilot died.

entities.name: Avengers
entities.description: Humanoid war machines designed by Urza and controlled by command rods.

entities.name: Dragon engines
entities.description: Large fire-breathing automatons spearheading Mishra's attack on Kroog.

entities.name: Command rod
entities.description: A handheld device that lets a pilot order an avenger by voice.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Mishra's brass-helmed soldiers who attack Kroog.

entities.name: Yotians
entities.description: The defenders of Kroog.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: The attack on Kroog that begins the war.

events.summary: Kroog is attacked at dawn, and Sanwell and four other cadets stand in the orniary yard facing refurbished avengers, with Sanwell sick with nerves.
events.quote: Kroog died on a crimson morning.

events.summary: Llora calls the five cadets up to crew avengers and asks whether Sanwell is ready to fight for Kroog.
events.quote: Training is over. Today's the day you save Kroog.

events.summary: Sanwell is given a command rod and paired with the new prototype avenger, Sword One, and puts it through its commands.
Tawnos promotes the five cadets to full pilots and briefs them on the Mardun crossing and Mishra's dragon engines.
events.quote: The first waves of Mishra's force have crossed the Mardun; they control the River Wards.

events.summary: Tawnos orders the avengers to take down the dragon engines and tells the pilots to run if in danger, heading to Hench.
events.quote: We need you and your avengers to take down the dragon engines,

events.summary: A huge explosion and a dragon engine appear over the city as Tawnos hurries away.
events.quote: Roiling crimson smoke leapt into the sky.

events.summary: The pilots and their avengers push through burning streets, past bodies, to a plaza held by Yotian soldiers under Lieutenant Markos.
Fallaji troops attack the plaza barricade, and Llora orders Sanwell, Rica and Carlo to flank the dragon engine.
events.quote: Find a way to flank the engine and bring it down, pilot!

events.summary: The dragon engine's blast destroys the plaza, killing Llora, Markos, the other pilots and the soldiers.
events.quote: Llora and the other pilots, Lieutenant Markos and their soldiers—gone in a breath.

events.summary: Sanwell and Rica drag a screaming Carlo away and reach a crossroads plaza, wondering where to run.
events.quote: Like Tawnos told us—if we're in danger, we run.

events.summary: A column of Fallaji brasscaps appears and Sanwell sends Sword One and Sword Two to attack.
The two avengers slaughter the Fallaji front ranks, but Sword Two loses an arm and the Fallaji overrun Sword Two and Sword Three.
events.quote: The Fallaji brasscaps advanced, driven by their officers behind

events.summary: The Fallaji explode Sword Two's powerstone, burning Carlo and wounding Sanwell and Rica.
events.quote: The brasscaps detonated their bomb lances and killed Sword Two.

events.summary: Fallaji crossbowmen kill the crawling Carlo as Sanwell and Rica hide.
events.quote: A flurry of crossbow bolts thudded into Carlo's back, killing him.

events.summary: Sanwell orders Sword One to kill, and the wounded avenger rises from the dark as Sanwell throws down his rod and flees with Rica.
Aiman, a wounded Fallaji soldier pierced by three arrows, lies among the dead of Kroog crying for water.
At night Aiman sees a glowing blue ghost he takes for Death, which says it is too early and that it does not happen here, then vanishes.
Two weeks later Aiman's fever breaks; he has lost an eye but survives.

relations.quote: The cadets' instructor was red-faced and stern
The first waves of Mishra's force have crossed the Mardun

relations.note: The ghost tells Aiman 'Not yet', sparing his life.
